content.value: Consider a focused transducer with a radius of curvature of 10 cm and a diameter of 4 cm. (07) This transducer operates at a frequency of 3.5 MHz, and transmits a pulse of duration 0.857 µs. What is the axial and lateral resolution at the focal point of the transducer?
